Regarding the sentiment analysis of the provided text:

The text is primarily positive. The Japanese portion expresses strong enthusiasm and satisfaction with a new game. Key phrases like "驚くべき程度に中毒性があります" (addictive to an amazing degree), "グラフィックは素晴らしく" (graphics are wonderful), and "ストーリーラインは魅力的です" (storyline is engaging) indicate high praise. The final sentence, "多くの時間を費やしてしまいました" (I spent a lot of time on it), further reinforces the positive sentiment by implying the game was so enjoyable that the user lost track of time.
